create.title: Create workspace
create.importHint: Bring a workspace export in, with its history
create.name: Workspace name

empty.title: You're not in a workspace yet
empty.createHint: Create one with + in the sidebar, or ask someone to invite you.
empty.inviteHint: Once someone invites you to one, it shows up here.

guest.accessEnded: Your guest access to {{workspace}} has ended.
guest.accessEndedUnnamed: Your guest access to a workspace has ended.
guest.untilHint: On that day they leave the workspace. Admins hear of it three days before.
guest.saveFailed: Could not change the guest access
guest.endingSoon: Only guests whose access ends in the next 30 days
guest.noneEnding: No guest's access ends in the next 30 days.

inviteRequest.explain: Only admins invite people to this workspace. Send them a request and they decide.
inviteRequest.emailsHint: Separate them with commas or new lines. Up to {{max}} at once.
inviteRequest.tooMany: At most {{max}} addresses in one request.
inviteRequest.sent: Request sent. You'll hear in Activity when an admin answers.
inviteRequest.editDescription: Change who is invited or on what terms, then send the invites.
inviteRequest.declineDescription: They hear of it in Activity, with your note if you write one.

profileFields.explain: Fields every profile in this workspace has, such as a department, a manager or an office. Each person fills in their own; admins fill in the ones marked admins only.
profileFields.label: Label
profileFields.hintPlaceholder: Shown under the field when someone fills it in
profileFields.kindFixed: A field keeps its kind once it exists.
profileFields.optionsRemoved: Removing an option clears it from every profile that picked it.
profileFields.adminsOnlyHint: Everyone sees it, but only an admin can fill it in, as for an employee number.
profileFields.onCardHint: At most two fields show when someone hovers over a name.
profileFields.cardFull: Two fields already show on the hover card.
profileFields.reorderHint: Drag a field to change the order profiles show them in, or focus its handle and use the arrow keys.
profileFields.deleteDescription_zero: It is removed from every profile. Nobody has filled it in yet.
profileFields.deleteDescription_one: It is removed from every profile, with the {{count}} value filled in.
profileFields.deleteDescription_other: It is removed from every profile, with the {{count}} values filled in.

customResponses.explain: When someone writes one of a response's phrases in a channel or thread, {{name}} answers with one of its answers. A response answers at most once a minute in a channel, and never in a direct message.
customResponses.loadFailed: Could not load the custom responses.
customResponses.readOnly: Only admins can edit custom responses in this workspace.
customResponses.triggersHint: A phrase matches as whole words, whatever the case. In Japanese and other text without spaces it matches anywhere.
customResponses.answersHint: With more than one answer, one is picked at random each time.

general.name: Workspace name
general.linkPreviewsHint: Show a card with the title and image of pages linked in messages. The server fetches each public page to build it.
general.gifsHint: Let people search GIPHY from the message box and send what they pick. Browsers fetch the search and the GIFs from GIPHY directly, and an instance admin has to add a GIPHY key first.
general.gifRatingHint: GIPHY leaves out GIFs rated above this.
general.softDeleted: This workspace was soft-deleted. You can restore it to make it visible to members again.
general.deleteExplain: Deleting a workspace is irreversible (hard) or hides it from members (soft).
general.deleteDescription: Choose how to delete this workspace
general.softHint: Hides the workspace from members. Its admins and instance admins still see it, and its owner or an instance admin can restore it.
general.hardHint: Permanently deletes everything: channels, messages, members. This cannot be undone.

members.stepDownConfirm: Step down to admin? Only an owner can make you an owner again.
members.otherOwners: Another owner remains, so you can step down to admin or leave the workspace.
members.onlyOwner: You're the only owner. To step down or leave, first make someone else an owner: pick Owner in their row.
members.exportStarted: Export started for {{name}}. It appears under Exports.

invites.sent: Invite sent to {{email}}. You can also send them the link yourself.
invites.emailFailed: The invite email to {{email}} could not be sent. Send them this link yourself.
invites.noEmail: Email is not set up on this instance, so nothing was sent. Send {{email}} this link yourself.
invites.copyFailed: Failed to copy the invite link
invites.revokeDescription: Its link stops working at once, including copies already sent.

erase.title: Erase {{name}}'s data?
erase.description: This applies to every workspace on this instance and cannot be undone.
erase.replaced: Their name, email ({{email}}), avatar and bio are replaced with Deleted user.
erase.signedOut: They are signed out everywhere and can no longer sign in.
erase.deleted: Their photos, passkeys, authenticator, recovery codes, notification keywords, push subscriptions, sidebar sections and preferences are deleted.
erase.messages: Their messages stay readable, shown as from Deleted user.

retention.intro: Messages and files older than the period are deleted for good by a nightly job. There is no undo, and an export taken before the change is the only copy that remains.
retention.channelOverrides: Let channels keep messages for their own period
retention.channelOverridesHint: A channel's admins can then set a shorter or longer period, or forever, in its settings. Files keep the workspace period.
retention.nothingRemoved: Nothing is removed while both are kept forever.
retention.countFailed: Could not count what would go
retention.removedNow: About {{messages}} and {{files}} would be removed now.

analytics.intro: Counts only, never what anyone wrote. A member is active on a day they post, react or read a conversation. Days run midnight to midnight UTC.

quiet.empty: Every channel has had a message in the last {{days}} days.
quiet.description: Nobody can post in an archived channel. It stays readable and searchable, and a channel admin can unarchive it.

exports.intro: An export is a tar archive of the workspace in JSON lines. Its download link works once and expires after a day.
exports.includeDmsHint: Private conversations between members. Asking for them is recorded in the audit log.
exports.ownerOnly: Only the workspace owner can export the whole workspace.

slackImport.intro: The .zip from Slack's <slack>Export workspace data</slack>. Imported messages keep their original dates, so nobody is notified about a conversation from two years ago.
slackImport.dryRunHint: Report what would happen, write nothing.
slackImport.nameRequired: Name the workspace to import into
slackImport.empty: No imports yet. A dry run first is the cheap way to see what will not convert.
slackImport.retryFailed: Could not start that import again
slackImport.archiveGone: The export was deleted {{date}}, so this run can't be started again. Upload it again to finish the import.
slackImport.discardDescription: This deletes {{source}} from the server now. The run can't be started again; to finish the import, upload the export again.

scim.intro: An identity provider such as Okta or Entra ID creates, renames and deactivates accounts on this instance through /api/scim/v2 with one of these tokens.
scim.copyNow: Copy this now. It is not shown again, and nobody can read it back later.
scim.revokeDescription: The identity provider using it stops provisioning at once.

customEmoji.name: Emoji name
customEmoji.empty: No custom emoji yet. Anything you add here can be typed as :name:.

userGroups.empty: No groups yet. A group gives a team one handle to mention.

apps.missing: That app is no longer installed.
apps.installedHint: Everything connected to this workspace: who added it, what it can do and whether it is working.
apps.availableHint: Connected apps turn links into cards with live details. Each person connects their own account, so a card only ever shows what the person who posted the link can see.
apps.buildHint: A bot user and a token for something your team writes itself.
apps.hiddenChannels_one: {{count}} private channel you are not in
apps.hiddenChannels_other: {{count}} private channels you are not in

card.turnedOff: An admin has turned this app off.
card.askAdmin: Ask a workspace admin to set this app up.

setup.reuseHint: Add the {{api}} API to it first.
setup.secretStored: Stored — leave blank to keep it
setup.installLead: Nobody can connect an account until you agree. For each person who connects, it will be able to:

request.title: Ask for an app
request.hint: Only an admin can add one. Your request lands in their notifications.
request.name: What should be added?

make.intro: An app has a bot user and a token of its own. It reads and writes only in the channels it is added to, with the scopes given here. The API it calls is described in the bot API guide.
make.name: App name
make.failed: The app could not be made
make.consentLead: Its token is made when you agree. With it, the app will be able to:

token.copyNow: Copy {{name}}'s token now. It is not shown again, and nobody can read it back later.
token.label: Bot token

page.readOnly: Only a workspace admin can change or remove it.
page.workflow: Change or turn it off in Workflows.

hook.secretNote: Copy it now: it is not shown again. It signs everything sent from now on.
hook.reinstallNote: Copy it now: it is not shown again. The URL it had before no longer works.
hook.rotateNote: Copy it now: it is not shown again. The old URL stopped working.
hook.removeDescription: It stops at once. What it already posted stays.

bot.stopped: Turning it on gives it a new token and signing secret, and you become the person it acts for. The token and secret it had stay refused.
bot.moreLead: Its token keeps working, and from now on the app will also be able to:
bot.removeDescription: Its token stops working at once, and its slash commands and webhooks are removed with it. What it posted stays.

kinds.message: A message in a channel it is in
kinds.reaction_added: A reaction is added in a channel it is in
kinds.reaction_removed: A reaction is removed in a channel it is in
kinds.member_joined_channel: Somebody joins a channel it is in
kinds.channel_archived: A channel it is in is archived

events.socketModeHint: The app opens a socket to this instance and takes its events and slash commands there, so it needs no public URL.
events.interactivitySocket: Buttons, menus and modals in its messages reach the app over its socket. Off, they stay disabled.
events.interactivityUrl: Buttons, menus and modals in its messages are posted to the request URL. Off, they stay disabled.
events.homeHint: Its conversation gets a Home tab, which the app fills for each person with views.publish.
events.requestUrlHint: Events are posted here, signed with the signing secret. The URL has to answer a challenge before it is saved.
events.appTokenNote: Copy it now; it is not shown again. It opens sockets and does nothing else, and a new one closes every socket the old one opened.

shortcuts.title: Shortcuts
shortcuts.intro: Global shortcuts sit in the composer's shortcut menu and in the quick switcher; message shortcuts sit under More actions on messages in conversations the app is in. Using one sends the app its callback ID. At most {{max}} of each.
shortcuts.name: Name
shortcuts.descriptionPlaceholder: Ask the help desk for something
shortcuts.failed: The shortcuts could not be saved

incoming.title: Incoming webhooks
incoming.intro: Post into a channel from anything that can send {"text":"…"}.

outgoing.title: Outgoing webhooks
outgoing.intro: Messages in the channels you pick are POSTed to your URL, signed with the secret below. Everyone in those channels can see that the integration is attached.

row.rotate: Rotate — the old value stops working immediately
row.deleteIncoming: Anything still posting to its URL will be refused.
row.deleteOutgoing: Messages stop being sent to its URL.

failed.turnOn: Failed to turn the webhook on
